unit.title: Language exchange
canDo: Say what languages you speak, and how well
Offer to teach and ask to learn
Answer a compliment on your Chinese

vocabulary.usageNote: 汉语 is the textbook and exam word; in conversation people mostly say 中文.
Northern speech adds -r: yìdiǎnr. In the south people say 一点 yìdiǎn.

example.py: Nǐ jiāo wǒ Yīngyǔ, hǎo ma?

example.en: I'd like to make Chinese friends.

vocabulary.usageNote: Surname + 老师 is how you address a teacher: 王老师.

grammar.explanation: 会 is a skill you have learned: 会说中文, 会写汉字. 能 is being able or free to do something right now: 我能教你, 明天我不能去. The negatives are 不会 and 不能.

commonMistakes.why: Speaking a language is a learned skill, so 会 is the usual choice.

grammar.pattern: verb + 一点儿 · 有点儿 + adjective
grammar.explanation: 一点儿 is an amount, after a verb or adjective: 说一点儿中文, 慢一点儿. 有点儿 goes before an adjective and usually sounds like a mild complaint: 汉字有点儿难.

commonMistakes.why: Before an adjective, use 有点儿.

dialogue.title: At the language corner
dialogue.setting: Chen Yu meets Anna at a language-exchange evening.

lines.speaker: anna

lines.speaker: anna
lines.zh: 谢谢！我还在学。汉字很难。
lines.py: Xièxie! Wǒ hái zài xué. Hànzì hěn nán.
lines.en: Thanks! I'm still learning. Characters are hard.

conversation.aiPartnerBrief: You are 陈宇, a student at a language exchange. Use HSK 1 words. Praise the learner's Chinese once and see how they respond.

pragmatics.situation: Someone says your Chinese is good

natural.py: Xièxie! Wǒ hái zài xué ne.

tooBlunt.py: Duì, wǒ de Zhōngwén hěn hǎo.

pragmatics.note: Accept with thanks and a little modesty. 哪里哪里 is the old-style humble reply; friends your age usually just say 谢谢.
荣幸 (honoured) belongs at formal events, not at a language corner.

tasks.statement: The speaker doesn't speak any Chinese.
tasks.why: 一点儿 means a little, not none.

tasks.statement: The speaker finds characters a bit hard.
tasks.why: 有点儿难 is "a bit hard".
Answer a 会 question with 会 or 不会.

lines.zh: 我叫安娜。我【会】说英语，也会说一点儿中文。我每天【写】汉字。很高兴【认识】你！
lines.py: Wǒ jiào Ānnà. Wǒ huì shuō Yīngyǔ, yě huì shuō yìdiǎnr Zhōngwén. Wǒ měi tiān xiě Hànzì. Hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ!
lines.en: I'm Anna. I speak English and a little Chinese. I write characters every day. Nice to meet you!
